package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.ClassStaticAccessor
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.FixedLimits
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.DriverFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPoint.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StageKind.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.BlockScope
import kotlin.test.*
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

/** Physical operations run through the real driver. Helper projections alone
 * cannot satisfy these report, handoff, port and local-interface checks. */
class LoopBlocksIntegrationTest {
    private val a = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
    private val b = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
    private val returned = AccessPathBase.Return

    private fun observedCall(f: DriverFixtures, touched: Set<AccessPathBase>, transfer: StatementSummary,
                             sinks: List<SinkRule> = emptyList(), actions: List<CleanStep> = emptyList()): CallPlan {
        val identity = f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, *touched.map(::keepEdge).toTypedArray())
        val sourceStage = transfer.edges.any { it.isSource } || transfer.sources.isNotEmpty()
        return CallPlan(touched, listOf(
            CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, identity),
            CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, actions),
            CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, if (sourceStage) SOURCES else UNRESOLVED, transfer),
            CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
            CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, identity),
        ), sinks, BEFORE, AFTER)
    }

    private fun getterCall(f: DriverFixtures, getter: MethodKey): CallPlan = CallPlan(setOf(STATIC, b), listOf(
        CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, keepEdge(STATIC))),
        CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
        CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(getter)),
        CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
        CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, keepEdge(STATIC),
            starEdge(returned, emptyList(), b, emptyList()))),
    ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER)

    @Test fun `two successive loops retain scoped static guidance and resolve the later physical finding in FULL`() {
        DriverFixtures().use { f ->
            val p = f.program
            // main: prefix; while { a=sourceAtG(); C.shared=a; }
            //               while { b=get(); sinkT(b.g); } return;
            val root = p.method("two loop static root", listOf(
                listOf(1),           // 0 prefix
                listOf(2, 4),        // 1 L1 header: iterate or leave
                listOf(3),           // 2 source at a.g.$
                listOf(1),           // 3 real static write; repeat
                listOf(5, 7),        // 4 L2 header: iterate or leave
                listOf(6),           // 5 real getter call
                listOf(4),           // 6 physical sink; repeat
                listOf(8),           // 7 return transfer
                emptyList(),         // 8 normal boundary
                emptyList(),         // 9 exceptional boundary, unreachable forward
            ), normalExit = 8, exceptionalExit = 9, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()
            val getter = p.method("two loop static getter", listOf(listOf(1), listOf(2), emptyList()), 2).key()
            val g = p.field("g")
            val cls = f.manager.accessors.index(ClassStaticAccessor("Box"))
            val field = p.field("shared")
            val slot = listOf(cls, field)
            val atom = p.mark("T")
            val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(atom)
            val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(a, listOf(g), Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
            val sourcePlan = observedCall(f, setOf(a), f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, source))
            assertTrue(sourcePlan.stages.filterIsInstance<CallStage.Edges>().any { stage ->
                stage.kind == SOURCES && stage.summary.edges.any { it.forward === source }
            }, "The physical source must use SOURCES so its backward hit grants the next forward permission")
            p.call(root, 2, sourcePlan)
            val write = starEdge(a, emptyList(), STATIC, slot)
            p.staticWrite(root, 3, Pattern(write.to, ExclusionSet.Empty), write,
                f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, keepEdge(a), write))
            val read = starEdge(STATIC, slot, returned, emptyList())
            p.staticRead(getter, 1, read, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, read))
            p.call(root, 5, getterCall(f, getter))
            val sink = SinkRule(f.rule("two loop static sink"), 0,
                listOf(p.pattern(b, listOf(g), mark = mark)), emptyList())
            p.call(root, 6, observedCall(f, setOf(b), f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, keepEdge(b)), listOf(sink)))

            val layout = f.shared.contexts.blockLayout(root)
            val composition1 = layout[layout.root]
            val loop1 = checkNotNull(composition1.loop)
            val after1 = layout[checkNotNull(composition1.after)]
            val loop2 = checkNotNull(after1.loop)
            assertEquals(composition1.after, layout[loop2].parent,
                "L2 belongs to the complete AL1 composition")
            assertTrue(layout[checkNotNull(after1.before)].instructions.isEmpty(), "BL2 is an empty logical block")
            assertEquals(loop1, layout.ownerOf(3))
            assertEquals(loop2, layout.ownerOf(6))

            val driver = f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1, 1, 2, 3, 4)), budget = 20.seconds,
                run1MarkMode = MarkMode.FULL)
            val report = driver.analyze(listOf(root))
            assertEquals(RunStatus.COMPLETE, report.end.status)
            assertTrue(f.results.all { it.status == RunStatus.COMPLETE })
            assertTrue(f.results.flatMap { it.analyzers }.all { it.key in setOf(root, getter) },
                "Local blocks must not create generated public method identities")
            assertTrue(f.configs.all { it.mode.markMode == MarkMode.FULL })
            assertTrue(f.configs.any { it.index == 2 }, "The run-1 static candidate needs the backward handoff")
            assertEquals(0, driver.frontiers.first().reportedSinks, "Run-1 static approximation cannot settle this finding")
            assertTrue(report.end.run >= 3, "The finding must survive a real restricted backward run")
            val backwardRoot = f.results.single { it.runIndex == 2 }.analyzers.single { it.key == root }
            assertTrue(checkNotNull(backwardRoot.sourceHits).occurrences().any { hit ->
                hit.method == root && hit.statement == p.inst(root, 2) && hit.forward === source
            }, "The reverse source transfer must record the original physical source occurrence")
            assertTrue(f.configs.single { it.index == 3 }.seeds.allowsSource(root, p.inst(root, 2), source),
                "Run-3 must use the source permission produced by the real run-2 source callback")
            if (report.entries.none { it.descriptor.key.ruleId == sink.rule.id }) {
                println(buildString {
                    fun image(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts): String =
                        "${original.members.map { it.toPattern() }} -> ${f.ops.leaves(value).toList()} layer=${value.layer} protected=${(value as? TaintTree)?.nonSubsumable != null}"
                    fun terminal(row: TargetSummary): String = "${row.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} -> ${row.target}"
                    appendLine("TWO_LOOP_STATIC_TRACE end=${report.end}")
                    for (frontier in driver.frontiers) appendLine("frontier run=${frontier.run} demand=${frontier.demandEdges} targets=${frontier.targetDemand} reports=${frontier.reportedSinks}")
                    for (config in f.configs) appendLine("config run=${config.index} sourcePermission=${config.seeds.allowsSource(root, p.inst(root, 2), source)}")
                    for (result in f.results) for (actor in result.analyzers) {
                        appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} method=${actor.key.method.name} ROOT rows=${actor.summaries.all().map { image(it.first, it.second) }.toList()} targets=${actor.targets.map(::terminal)} sources=${actor.sourceHits?.entries()?.toList()}")
                        for (block in actor.blockSummaries()) appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} BLOCK key=${block.key} rows=${block.summaries.all().map { image(it.first, it.second) }.toList()}")
                        for (block in actor.blockTargets()) appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} TARGET scope=${block.scope} exit=${block.exit} rows=${block.rows.map(::terminal)}")
                    }
                    for (row in f.processed) appendLine("processed run=${row.run} method=${row.method.method.name} at=${row.delta.node.location.index} image=${image(row.delta.premise, row.delta.facts)}")
                })
            }
            assertEquals(listOf(sink.rule.id), report.entries.map { it.descriptor.key.ruleId },
                "end=${report.end}; frontiers=${driver.frontiers.map { Triple(it.run, it.demandEdges.values.sum(), it.reportedSinks) }}")
            assertEquals(p.inst(root, 6), report.entries.single().descriptor.key.statement)

            val first = f.results.first().analyzers.single { it.key == root }
            val localRows = first.blockSummaries().toList()
            assertTrue(localRows.isNotEmpty(), "The loop runtime must publish scoped snapshots, not use the flat method path")
            assertTrue(localRows.any { it.key.scope.block == loop1 }, "L1 has its own one-traversal rows")
            assertTrue(localRows.any { it.key.scope.block == loop2 }, "L2 has its own one-traversal rows")
            assertTrue(localRows.any { block -> block.summaries.all().any { it.second.base is AccessPathBase.LocalVar } },
                "Internal local conclusions must survive the public method summary-base filter")
            assertTrue(first.summaries.all().none { it.second.base is AccessPathBase.LocalVar })
            val outgoing = first.blockOutgoingTargets().filter { it.scope.block == loop2 }.toList()
            assertTrue(outgoing.any { block -> block.rows.any { it.target == Target.DemandTarget } },
                "The L2 sink has selected local terminal guidance")
            val backward = f.configs.single { it.index == 2 }
            val demand = checkNotNull(backward.demand)
            assertTrue(demand.hasSharedStaticCarry)
            assertTrue(demand.hasStaticCompletion)
            for (block in outgoing) {
                val reverseEntry = BlockScope(block.scope.block, block.exit)
                assertTrue(demand.scope(root, reverseEntry).initials(Reach.NORMAL, backward.admissionPolicy).isNotEmpty(),
                    "The opposite local entry retains its typed Target-to-ZERO permission")
            }
            assertTrue(f.processed.any { it.run == 2 && it.method == root &&
                it.delta.node in listOf(p.inst(root, 3), p.inst(root, 6)) },
                "Run-2 must visit the physical static write or consumer, not only a helper query")
            assertTrue(f.results.filter { it.direction == Direction.BACKWARD }.all { result ->
                result.analyzers.all { actor ->
                    actor.targets.none { it.target is Target.NormalTarget } &&
                        actor.blockTargets().flatMap { it.rows.asSequence() }.none { it.target is Target.NormalTarget }
                }
            })
        }
    }

    @Test fun `empty BL preserves repeat break throw and normal return ports without leaking a killed mark`() {
        DriverFixtures().use { f ->
            val p = f.program
            // x=sourceT(); while { repeat OR { clearAll(x); break; } OR throw; }
            // sinkClean(x); return x;   // Only the exceptional exit sink can report.
            val root = p.method("empty before loop exits", listOf(
                listOf(1, 2, 6),     // 0 header, also the method start
                listOf(0),           // 1 repeat
                listOf(3),           // 2 break through cleaner
                listOf(4),           // 3 clean normal-path sink
                listOf(5),           // 4 return transfer
                emptyList(),         // 5 normal boundary
                emptyList(),         // 6 exceptional boundary
            ), normalExit = 5, exceptionalExit = 6, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()
            val mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("T"))
            val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, PathFact(a, emptyList(), Tail.EXACT, mark), ExclusionSet.Empty)
            p.entry(root, RuleStatement(f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, source), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList()))
            val clean = CleanStep.Clean(Cleaner(a, null, CleanReach.AT_AND_BELOW, null))
            val identity = f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, keepEdge(a))
            p.call(root, 2, observedCall(f, setOf(a), identity, actions = listOf(clean)))
            val normalSink = SinkRule(f.rule("clean break sink"), 0, listOf(p.pattern(a, mark = mark)), emptyList())
            p.call(root, 3, observedCall(f, setOf(a), identity, listOf(normalSink)))
            p.statement(root, 4, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP, starEdge(a, emptyList(), returned, emptyList())))
            val thrownSink = SinkRule(f.rule("throw exit sink"), 0, listOf(p.pattern(a, mark = mark)), emptyList())
            p.exit(root, 6, ExitRules(RuleStatement(StatementSummary.EMPTY, StatementSummary.EMPTY,
                listOf(thrownSink)), false, emptySet()))
            val layout = f.shared.contexts.blockLayout(root)
            val top = layout[layout.root]
            assertTrue(layout[checkNotNull(top.before)].instructions.isEmpty())
            val loop = checkNotNull(top.loop)
            val repeat = checkNotNull(layout.port(1, 0)).id
            val breakPhysical = checkNotNull(layout.port(0, 2)).id
            val breakPort = checkNotNull(layout.normalExitForRoute(breakPhysical)).id
            val throwPort = checkNotNull(layout.port(0, 6)).id
            assertEquals(setOf(repeat), layout[loop].repeatPorts.toSet())

            val driver = f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1, 1, 2)), budget = 20.seconds, run1MarkMode = MarkMode.FULL)
            val report = driver.analyze(listOf(root))
            assertEquals(RunStatus.COMPLETE, report.end.status)
            assertEquals(listOf(thrownSink.rule.id), report.entries.map { it.descriptor.key.ruleId })
            assertEquals(p.inst(root, 6), report.entries.single().descriptor.key.statement)
            val first = f.results.first().analyzers.single { it.key == root }
            val rows = first.blockSummaries().filter { it.key.scope.block == loop }.toList()
            assertTrue(rows.isNotEmpty(), "The original method actor must own actual loop snapshots")
            assertTrue(setOf(repeat, breakPort, throwPort).all { port -> rows.any { it.key.exit == port } },
                "Stored traversal rows keep the feedback, shared normal interface and typed exceptional port")
            assertTrue(first.summaries.all().none { (_, facts) -> facts.base == returned &&
                f.ops.leaves(facts).any { it.fact.mark == mark } },
                "The thrown T path cannot create a normal return summary; the break path clears it")
            assertTrue(first.targets.none { row -> (row.target as? Target.NormalTarget)?.let {
                f.shared.reportCatalog.descriptor(it.id).key.ruleId == normalSink.rule.id
            } == true })
            assertTrue(first.blockTargets().flatMap { it.rows.asSequence() }.none { row ->
                (row.target as? Target.NormalTarget)?.let {
                    f.shared.reportCatalog.descriptor(it.id).key.ruleId == normalSink.rule.id
                } == true
            })
        }
    }
}

proof13/StaticCarryC5Preimage.lean.text:
/-
C5-only shared-static-carry adapter model. A static class+field anchor is an
indivisible Slot; its one counted field is the budget coordinate. This is not
a complete static ownership or packed Facts adapter. Ordinary C2 is unchanged.
The source-projected same-position image keeps old FLOW EXACT normalization.
The helper selects an existing ANY->ANY virtual pair only after canStore permits
it. Actual Facts, their E, layer and literal H are never edited by that choice.
-/
import StarOrAnyDesignProofFixed

namespace StaticCarryC5Preimage
open ApSpec StarOrAnyDesign
abbrev Mark := StarOrAnyDesign.Mark
abbrev Layer := StarOrAnyDesign.Layer
abbrev Head := StarOrAnyDesign.Head
abbrev PlainHead := StarOrAnyDesign.PlainHead

structure Slot where
  owner : Nat
  field : Acc
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Endpoint where
  slot : Slot
  head : Head
  mark : Mark
  exclusion : List Acc := []
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Pair where
  entry : Endpoint
  exit : Endpoint
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def isSTAR (p : Endpoint) : Bool := decide (p.head = .plain .star)
def isMAY (p : Endpoint) : Bool := decide (p.head = .plain .may)
def isFLOW (p : Endpoint) : Bool := match p.mark with | .flow => true | _ => false
def sameSlotMark (a b : Endpoint) : Bool := decide (a.slot = b.slot ∧ a.mark = b.mark)
def queryMAY (p : Endpoint) : Endpoint := {p with head := .plain .may,exclusion := []}
def samePair (p : Endpoint) : Pair := ⟨p,p⟩

/-- Same-coordinate part of current structural canEmitInitial: only STAR stored
keys are classified below. The static anchor includes a field, so class-only
initial exceptions do not apply. Its counted depth is exactly one. -/
def requestedSTAR (run limit : Nat) (d raw : Endpoint) : Bool :=
  decide (run = 2 ∧ 1 < limit) && isSTAR d && decide (raw.exclusion = d.exclusion)
def rawSameImage (run limit : Nat) (d raw : Endpoint) : Bool :=
  sameSlotMark d raw && decide (1 ≤ limit) &&
  match raw.head with
  | .plain .exact => decide (raw.exclusion = [])
  | .plain .star => requestedSTAR run limit d raw
  | .starOrAny => (isMAY d && decide (raw.exclusion = [])) || requestedSTAR run limit d raw
  | _ => false
/-- At one identical slot: MAY covers the raw STAR-like preimage; STAR demands
must have no more field exclusions than that preimage. EXACT is at the head. -/
def insideSame (raw d : Endpoint) : Bool :=
  if isMAY d then true
  else if isSTAR d then
    match raw.head with
    | .plain .exact => true
    | .plain .star | .starOrAny => d.exclusion.all (fun a => decide (a ∈ raw.exclusion))
    | _ => false
  else false

def canStoreSTAR (run limit : Nat) (d stored : Endpoint) : Bool :=
  if !isSTAR stored then false else
    let fits := fun raw => rawSameImage run limit d raw && insideSame raw d
    fits stored || fits {stored with head := .starOrAny} ||
      (isFLOW stored && decide (stored.exclusion = []) &&
        fits {stored with head := .plain .exact})

/-- Pure query selection. `legacy` is the existing same-slot family row. No row
is inserted, emitted, interned or delivered to C2 by this function. -/
def selectCarry (canStore : Endpoint → Endpoint → Bool) (stored : Endpoint) (legacy : Pair) : Pair :=
  if !canStore legacy.entry stored && isSTAR stored then
    let virtual := queryMAY stored
    if canStore virtual stored then samePair virtual else legacy
  else legacy

def p : Endpoint := ⟨⟨17,7⟩,.plain .star,.full 11,[]⟩
def legacy : Pair := samePair p
def capPolicy : Endpoint → Endpoint → Bool := canStoreSTAR 2 1
/-- Counted projection only: the native STATIC class anchor stays in Slot.
The ordinary scalar lemma supplies this exact one-field image witness. -/
def asPattern (e : Endpoint) : StarOrAnyDesign.Pattern :=
  ⟨e.slot.owner+1,[e.slot.field],e.head,e.mark,e.exclusion⟩

theorem capped_MAY_actual_has_a_concrete_SOA_initial_and_stored_STAR_preimage :
    c2 .starThenMayForAny 2 ⟨.backward,1⟩
      ⟨18,[7],.any,.full 11⟩
      ⟨⟨18,[7],.plain .may,.full 11,[]⟩,.demand,false⟩ =
        [⟨⟨18,[7],.starOrAny,.full 11,[]⟩,.demand⟩] ∧
    eraseSeed ⟨⟨18,[7],.starOrAny,.full 11,[]⟩,.demand⟩ =
      ⟨asPattern p,.demand⟩ := by decide

theorem capped_concrete_STAR_family_rejects_but_existing_MAY_family_accepts :
    capPolicy p p = false ∧ capPolicy (queryMAY p) p = true ∧
    selectCarry capPolicy p legacy = samePair (queryMAY p) := by decide

theorem accepted_legacy_pair_is_kept_without_any_new_query_pair
    (canStore : Endpoint → Endpoint → Bool) (stored : Endpoint) (old : Pair)
    (accepted : canStore old.entry stored = true) :
    selectCarry canStore stored old = old := by simp [selectCarry,accepted]

theorem rejected_MAY_candidate_keeps_the_legacy_row
    (canStore : Endpoint → Endpoint → Bool) (stored : Endpoint) (old : Pair)
    (refused : canStore (queryMAY stored) stored = false) :
    selectCarry canStore stored old = old := by
  unfold selectCarry
  split <;> simp [refused]

theorem nonSTAR_stored_key_keeps_the_existing_legacy_pair
    (canStore : Endpoint → Endpoint → Bool) (stored : Endpoint) (old : Pair)
    (notSTAR : isSTAR stored = false) :
    selectCarry canStore stored old = old := by simp [selectCarry,notSTAR]

theorem any_selected_virtual_pair_requires_the_unchanged_entry_permission
    (canStore : Endpoint → Endpoint → Bool) (stored : Endpoint) (old : Pair)
    (changed : selectCarry canStore stored old ≠ old) :
    isSTAR stored = true ∧ canStore old.entry stored = false ∧
      canStore (queryMAY stored) stored = true ∧
      selectCarry canStore stored old = samePair (queryMAY stored) := by
  unfold selectCarry at changed ⊢
  cases oldGate : canStore old.entry stored <;> cases starGate : isSTAR stored <;>
    cases newGate : canStore (queryMAY stored) stored <;>
    simp_all

theorem virtual_pair_keeps_owner_field_and_mark_on_both_paired_endpoints (stored : Endpoint) :
    (samePair (queryMAY stored)).entry.slot = stored.slot ∧
    (samePair (queryMAY stored)).exit.slot = stored.slot ∧
    (samePair (queryMAY stored)).entry.mark = stored.mark ∧
    (samePair (queryMAY stored)).exit.mark = stored.mark ∧
    (samePair (queryMAY stored)).entry = (samePair (queryMAY stored)).exit := by
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

theorem nonempty_stored_E_is_not_cleared_and_old_FLOW_preimage_stays_accepted :
    let excluded := {p with exclusion := [9]}
    capPolicy (queryMAY excluded) excluded = false ∧
    selectCarry capPolicy excluded (samePair excluded) = samePair excluded ∧
    excluded.exclusion = [9] ∧
    capPolicy {p with mark := .flow} {p with mark := .flow} = true := by decide

/- Pointwise scalar output restriction, projected from restrictConclusionOnly.
Exit is STAR/EmptyE or ANY at the SAME position. All candidate E stays input;
only the ordinary restricted RESULT may relocate as the source rule specifies. -/
inductive Position where | at | below (first : Acc) (rest : List Acc) | above (first : Acc) (rest : List Acc) | apart
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive ExitKind where | starEmpty | may
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Geometry where
  position : Position
  head : PlainHead
  exclusion : List Acc
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Candidate where
  geometry : Geometry
  layer : Layer
  protection : Bool
  mark : Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def admits (excluded : List Acc) (first : Acc) : Bool := !decide (first ∈ excluded)
def restrictGeometry (exit : ExitKind) (g : Geometry) : Option Geometry :=
  match g.position with
  | .at =>
    match g.head,exit with
    | .must,.starEmpty => some {g with exclusion := g.exclusion ++ []}
    | _,_ => some g
  | .below _ _ => some g
  | .above first _ =>
    match g.head with
    | .may | .must => if admits g.exclusion first then some {g with position := .at,exclusion := []} else none
    | .star => if admits g.exclusion first then some g else none
    | .exact => none
  | .apart => none

def restrictCandidate (exit : ExitKind) (c : Candidate) : Option Candidate :=
  (restrictGeometry exit c.geometry).map (fun g => {c with geometry := g})
def gatedRestriction (sameField markMatches : Bool) (exit : ExitKind) (c : Candidate) : Option Candidate :=
  if sameField && markMatches then restrictCandidate exit c else none

theorem STAR_EmptyE_and_MAY_same_position_have_equal_scalar_output_restriction (g : Geometry) :
    restrictGeometry .starEmpty g = restrictGeometry .may g := by
  cases g with
  | mk position head excluded =>
    cases position <;> cases head <;> simp [restrictGeometry]

theorem identical_field_and_mark_gates_preserve_the_restriction_equality
    (sameField markMatches : Bool) (c : Candidate) :
    gatedRestriction sameField markMatches .starEmpty c =
      gatedRestriction sameField markMatches .may c := by
  simp [gatedRestriction,restrictCandidate,
    STAR_EmptyE_and_MAY_same_position_have_equal_scalar_output_restriction]

theorem output_restriction_preserves_every_supplied_layer_mark_and_literal_H
    (exit : ExitKind) (c result : Candidate)
    (selected : restrictCandidate exit c = some result) :
    result.layer = c.layer ∧ result.mark = c.mark ∧ result.protection = c.protection := by
  cases observed : restrictGeometry exit c.geometry with
  | none => simp only [restrictCandidate,observed,Option.map_none] at selected; cases selected
  | some geometry =>
    have same : {c with geometry := geometry} = result := by
      simpa only [restrictCandidate,observed,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] using selected
    rw [← same]
    exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

def restrictCarry (pair : Pair) (stored : Endpoint) (c : Candidate) : Option Candidate :=
  if capPolicy pair.entry stored && sameSlotMark pair.entry pair.exit && sameSlotMark pair.entry stored then
    match pair.exit.head with
    | .plain .star => if pair.exit.exclusion = [] then restrictCandidate .starEmpty c else none
    | .plain .may => restrictCandidate .may c
    | _ => none
  else none

def candidate : Candidate := ⟨⟨.at,.star,[]⟩,.demand,true,.full 11⟩

theorem capped_C5_recovery_keeps_the_candidate_and_does_not_cross_a_different_field :
    restrictCarry legacy p candidate = none ∧
    restrictCarry (selectCarry capPolicy p legacy) p candidate = some candidate ∧
    restrictCarry (selectCarry capPolicy p legacy)
      {p with slot := ⟨17,8⟩} candidate = none := by decide

def check : Bool :=
  !capPolicy p p && capPolicy (queryMAY p) p &&
  decide (selectCarry capPolicy p legacy = samePair (queryMAY p)) &&
  decide (restrictCarry (selectCarry capPolicy p legacy) p candidate = some candidate) &&
  decide (p.exclusion = [])

theorem executable_C5_only_adapter_cells : check = true := by decide

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Root-only C5 shared-carry preimage adapter check; no native jobs."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PRESERVED={'RestrictedInitialPolicy': '3a42cc1eb3209c82400ba528bdb1e80ba17bc09540e19e59b0d5272f9fd7c5f0', 'MayInitialToStarAuditRootChecked': 'afe6f23f44a937bda291f0444476737e418a1fee574d597b9cb3cf7bbdb6a0c4', 'SelectedFullAdmissionProofFixed': 'c8e7c2bd1c79039991f2918ca4cbccca88b7787a25261d414704373af987785b', 'StarOrAnyDesignProofFixed': '705d2f474e039c517f8f33b4e7ffdec5af6436bd590e437a0df56392b4e4442c', 'StarOrAnyObligationsProofFixed': 'b63650cb76f437b668028a42f93b50b00a30130c857d73c7fbb3f4bd575a1cb2', 'PublicDemandHandoffCounterexample': 'ecb79a5ddda53f35de7c086bd20d679303c387eb26cc98a00d06a2e3f50317e1'}
NEW='StaticCarryC5Preimage'
NEW_SHA='78bb7d9ed219902ef605d900f85845d9045902897c464ed13152061cbee0c800'
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--root-authorized',action='store_true',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--models-dir',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--lean-root',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=HERE/'root-checks.json')
    args=parser.parse_args();assert args.root_authorized and not args.output.exists()
    def seals():
        for name,expected in PRESERVED.items():assert sha(args.models_dir/(name+'.lean'))==expected,name
        assert sha(HERE/(NEW+'.lean'))==NEW_SHA
    seals();outputs=[];commands=[]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='static-carry-c5-preimage-') as temporary:
        env=dict(os.environ);env['LEAN_PATH']=temporary+os.pathsep+env.get('LEAN_PATH','')
        sources=[(name,args.models_dir/(name+'.lean')) for name in list(PRESERVED)[:4]]+[(NEW,HERE/(NEW+'.lean'))]
        for name,path in sources:
            code=re.sub(r'/\-.*?\-/','',path.read_text(),flags=re.S);code=re.sub(r'--[^\n]*','',code)
            assert not re.search(r'^\s*(?:axiom|opaque|noncomputable)\b|\b(?:sorry|admit|Classical)\b',code,re.M),name
            command=['lake','env','lean','--root='+str(path.parent),'-M2048','-o',str(Path(temporary)/(name+'.olean')),str(path)]
            commands.append(command)
            result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=args.lean_root,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            print(result.stdout,end='',flush=True);outputs.append(result.stdout)
            assert result.returncode==0 and 'error:' not in result.stdout and 'sorryAx' not in result.stdout,name
    seals();combined='\n'.join(outputs);audits=[]
    for name,dependencies in re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms:\s*\[([^]]*)\]",combined,re.S):
        used=sorted(filter(None,dependencies.replace('\n','').replace(' ','').split(',')))
        assert set(used)<={'propext','Quot.sound'},(name,used);audits.append({'theorem':name,'axioms':used})
    for name in re.findall(r"'([^']+)' does not depend on any axioms",combined):audits.append({'theorem':name,'axioms':[]})
    selected=[a for a in audits if a['theorem'].startswith('StaticCarryC5Preimage.')]
    code=(HERE/(NEW+'.lean')).read_text();names=re.findall(r'^theorem (\w+)',code,re.M)
    assert len(names)==13 and names==re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\w+)',code,re.M)
    assert len(selected)==13 and {a['theorem'].split('.')[-1] for a in selected}==set(names)
    assert 'STATIC_CARRY_C5_PREIMAGE=true' in outputs[-1] and 'STATIC_CARRY_C5_PREIMAGE=false' not in outputs[-1]
    receipt={'state':'PASS_LOCAL_C5_SHARED_CARRY_PREIMAGE_ADAPTER_NOT_GLOBAL_OR_NATIVE_EQUIVALENCE',
      'checkedLocalLaws':13,'newModelSha256':NEW_SHA,'preservedModelPins':PRESERVED,
      'checkerSha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'newLawAxiomAudit':selected,'commands':commands,
      'scope':['Saturated one-counted-field static-slot image projection with explicit SOA actual witness',
       'C5-only same-slot/mark pair choice guarded by unchanged canStoreInitial',
       'Pointwise STAR/EmptyE vs MAY output restriction and supplied N/D/mark/H frame'],
      'notProved':['Complete native STATIC anchor/ownership and all image adapters',
       'Packed/native normalization and transportProtection equivalence',
       'Whole-program/native recovery or global source/sink soundness/progress',
       'Either pending public-handoff/loop-observer behavior decision'],
      'nativeJobsRun':False,'productionChanged':False}
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
